items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday; day-to-day per coach Jesse Minter. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) also not practicing.
items.why: Aggravated prior hamstring; not serious but missing Wed practice.
items.implication: Bateman/Moore/Wester upside if limited or OUT; monitor Fri.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery progressing; coach day-to-day, realistic W2 shot per reports.
items.implication: Monitor practice; high TE1 upside if active, Mayer holds otherwise.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey day-to-day with rib injury after hard hit; status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders. Monitored throughout week per Harbaugh.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; further testing, practice will decide.
items.implication: If OUT, Tre Harris primary beneficiary for targets/routes.

items.text: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling placed on IR (ankle), out at least 4 games.
items.implication: Opens snaps/targets for Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid 49ers WR injuries.
items.why: Stribling IR and depth chart opportunity boost Deebo's role.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/upside in most leagues.

items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries on waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders.
items.why: Precise handcuff/beneficiary mapping from early injury report.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for immediate opportunity.

items.text: Alvin Kamara absence makes Kendre Miller the clear waiver beneficiary and stash for Saints backfield.
items.why: Direct handcuff mapping on early injury report.
items.implication: Add Miller immediately if Kamara misses time.

items.text: Rashee Rice ran 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd only to Worthy) but saw just 2 targets for 7% share and tiny 2.5 aDOT (career 4.9). Needs serious volume to produce.
items.why: Routes present but targets and aDOT extremely low in return.
items.implication: Efficiency and volume concerns; monitor target share growth.
items.opportunity: High route participation (29/33) but low targets.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role confirmed.
items.why: Dominated opportunities, routes, and targets in first game with KC.
items.implication: High-end RB1 with every-down and receiving upside ROS.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, goal-line work implied.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 RB Utilization Score (99) in W1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 scrimmage yds + 2 rec TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1.
items.why: Dominant every-down share and efficiency vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Treat as locked RB1; history of similar profiles avg 23+ PPG.

items.text: Bucky Irving's 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Got only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked healthy. Strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line and route edge over Gainwell despite modest carries.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 with receiving and GL upside; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: Only inside-10 carry, 21 routes vs Gainwell 13, 7 targets.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 offensive snaps in Week 1 (jet sweep, screens, decoy); did not pass LOS on a route. Jags' specialized package intention clear; could have kept BTJ or not extended others.
items.why: Extremely limited, specialized package only; no real route running.
items.implication: Low fantasy outlook early; BTJ remains primary. Long season but role defined.

items.text: Travis Etienne in murky Saints committee even without Kamara: 58% snaps but only 43% attempts, 38% routes. Efficient but volume concerns; downgrades to low-end RB2 pending Kamara return.
items.why: Three-way split limited opportunities despite high play count.
items.implication: Kamara return further clouds; Miller stash.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion; Monday Night Miracle love and strong endorsement post-debut.
items.why: Explosive production and workhorse role in Chiefs debut.
